title: Certified Behavioral Retention for Continual Adaptation with Held-Out Anchors
abstract: arXiv:2610.40740v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual adaptation requires deciding not only how to update a model, but whether to commit an update without exceeding a declared budget for changes to protected behavior. We introduce Certified Anchor-Based Adaptation (CABA), a candidate-agnostic post-update gate that reserves historical observations from candidate optimization, compares old and candidate policies on frozen representations, and selects the largest tested interpolation coefficient whose worst-anchor forward KL divergence remains within budget. The finite check requires neither action labels nor complete trajectories. We develop a theory-led certification framework that separates measured anchor retention from conditional off-anchor guarantees. Under explicit representation-coverage and Lipschitz assumptions, an accepted update satisfies a uniform behavioral-divergence bound on protected support. translated_title: 基于留出锚点的持续适应认证行为保持
translated_abstract: 持续适应不仅需要决定如何更新模型，还需要决定是否在不超出针对受保护行为所声明的变更预算的前提下提交该更新。我们提出了认证锚点适应（CABA），这是一种与候选无关的更新后门控机制，它将历史观测数据保留在候选优化之外，在冻结的表示上比较旧策略与候选策略，并选出其最坏锚点前向KL散度仍保持在预算内的最大已测试插值系数。该有限检验既不需要动作标签，也不需要完整轨迹。我们开发了一个以理论为主导的认证框架，将实际测量的锚点保持性与条件性的锚点外保证分离开来。在明确的表示覆盖和Lipschitz假设下，被接受的更新在受保护支持集上满足一致的行为散度界。该分析为仿射softmax头给出了正则性界，概率……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CABA方法，通过在留出锚点上比较新旧策略、筛选最坏锚点前向KL散度不超预算的最大插值系数，在无需动作标签或完整轨迹的情况下为持续适应中的模型更新提供可认证的行为保持保证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CABA, a candidate-agnostic post-update gate that compares old and candidate policies on held-out anchors and selects the largest interpolation coefficient whose worst-anchor forward KL divergence stays within budget, providing certified behavioral retention for continual adaptation without requiring action labels or complete trajectories.
